title: Day20-v2 SFT baseline reset
context: Legacy Day20 has no selection-ready evidence because Code E2B and full112 are missing.
Code target indentation drift is the strongest current model/data failure signal.
The old run discovered its missing E2B runtime only after GPU training.
The selected GPU host is frozen before execution as RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell with torch 2.10.0+cu128.

Retry 1 changes only the raw-evidence JSON representation boundary (frozen TAT-QA tuple to durable JSON array); data, seed, LR, checkpoint targets, eval cases, frozen scorer, promotion gates, and model semantics are unchanged.

Retry 2 corrects only the Day20 wrapper call to the frozen single-argument HumanEval loader and normalizes its prefixed semantic hash for v3 identity; the frozen scorer/config/source bytes and all experiment semantics remain unchanged.
The complete Stage-A trajectory falsified A1/A2: all four checkpoints were gross failures, while A3 was supported by a pre-training live E2B attestation and zero sandbox infrastructure failures.
Root cause is causally confirmed at training-template label construction: 105/105 stored Code targets begin with four spaces, but 0/105 live nonmasked labels retain them.

assumptions.statement: Strict function-body targets remove Code boundary drift.
assumptions.prediction: At least one Probe checkpoint has Code eligibility >=7/8.
assumptions.falsifier: All verified Probe checkpoints remain below 7/8.

assumptions.statement: Balanced expanded data creates a feasible four-domain checkpoint window.
assumptions.prediction: A Probe strict pass exists or total gate deficit improves materially.
assumptions.falsifier: All complete probes are gross failures with the same signature.

assumptions.statement: Pre-training E2B smoke prevents infrastructure failure from being labeled model failure.
assumptions.prediction: No training starts without a matching live attestation.
assumptions.falsifier: Swift starts before E2B preflight passes.
